title: Payment reconciliation epic
description:
## Friendly Summary
Group for the reconciliation work.

## Technical
Parent for the actionable next steps; children below are the ranked steps.

title: Fix the thing
description:
## Friendly Summary
The nightly reconciliation job double counts refunds.

## Technical
In reconcile.py the refund rows are summed twice. Exclude rows with type=refund from the second pass. Add a test with the 2026-08 fixture.
acceptance_criteria: Test test_reconcile_refunds passes; nightly total matches the ledger for August.

title: Ask Mike for the August export
description:
## Friendly Summary
We cannot finish reconciliation until Mike sends the August export from the finance system.

## Technical
First step: ask Mike for the attachment. Then load it with scripts/load_export.py.
notes:
2026-08-20 (Scriba, session 3): chaser drafted, not yet sent.
2026-09-05 (Notarius, session 9): Mike replied: export received and saved under data/finance/2026-08.csv. Loading can start now.

title: Wire the new ledger client into the nightly job
description:
## Friendly Summary
Once the ledger client exists, the nightly job should use it.

## Technical
Replace the direct SQL in nightly.py with LedgerClient calls. Blocked on bs-b1.

title: Build the ledger client
description:
## Friendly Summary
A small client for the ledger API.

## Technical
New module ledger/client.py with get_balance(account) and list_entries(account, since). Tests with recorded fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Both methods covered by tests using the fixtures in tests/fixtures/ledger/.

title: Remove the legacy CSV path
description:
## Friendly Summary
The old CSV import is dead code now.

## Technical
Delete import_csv.py and its tests. Was blocked on bs-c1, which is closed.

title: Migrate CSV users to the API
Decide whether reconciliation lives inside the finance app
description:
## Friendly Summary
Options: (a) keep it as a script, (b) move it into the finance app, (c) both for a while. Harry to choose the shape.

## Technical
Affects where the tests live and who owns deploys.

title: Add tracing to the nightly job
description:
## Friendly Summary
We cannot see where the nightly job spends its time.

## Technical
Instrument nightly.py with OpenTelemetry spans and wire an exporter.

title: Nightly job crashes on empty ledger
Rotate the ledger API token
description:
## Friendly Summary
The token expires in September.

## Technical
Rotate in the provider console and update the Fly secret.

title: Someday: rewrite the job in Rust
description: Only worth doing if the nightly job ever exceeds an hour.

title: Write the reconciliation runbook
description:
## Friendly Summary
On-call needs a runbook for the nightly job.

## Technical
Write docs/runbooks/reconciliation.md covering restart, replay and the known failure modes.
design: Sections: overview, restart, replay, failure modes, contacts.
notes:
Filed by Notarius, session 2, 2026-08-10, on Harry's instruction.
Draft outline agreed with the on-call lead.
No date on this line either.
